name: St Dunstan and St John Vianney, Moston
shortName: St Dunstan and St John Vianney

boundary.description: From the roundabout joining Moston Lane, Charlestown Road and Ainsbrook Avenue, by a bee-line E to and across Colgrove Avenue, to and S along Lightbowne Road and Linford Avenue to the end of the road. Then by a beeline to the junction of Nuthurst Road and Blandford Drive, W along Nuthurst Road, Moston Lane East, to the junction of Moston Lane East and Belgrave Road, and by a bee-line to and W along Moston Brook to the point opposite Broadhurst Primary School and by a bee-line to the junction of St Mary’s Road and Williams Road, N along St Mary’s Road to the railway. W along the railway to and NW along Thorp Road, and along a footpath through Moston Vale to Carisbrook Street and its junction with Conran Street. NE along Conran Street and footpath to and W along Church Lane, Hillier Street to the point opposite Hillier Street North. N along Hillier Street North to and E along Moston Lane and N along Clough Lane to its junction with Glen Avenue, then by a straight line NW to Crowden Road, and W along Crowden Road, Moston Lane to the roundabout.

internalBoundaries.name: Former boundary between St Dunstan and St John Vianney
internalBoundaries.description: From the point where the railway crosses St Mary’s Road, N along St Mary’s Road, W along Joyce Street, Arbory Avenue (both sides in St Dunstan parish) to Lightbowne Road, and by a bee-line to and along Millais Street, Moston Lane, Bluebell Avenue to the end of the road. Then by a bee-line to Oak Bank Avenue, Gill Street, Glen Avenue to its junction with Clough Road.
